summary: Arcade taxi game in an original procedural coastal city: pick color-coded fares, race patience timers with drifts, near misses, jumps and 18 shortcuts to build Pulse and Tailwind, across Arcade Shift, Quick Shift, Time Trial with ghosts, and a 10-lesson Skill School.
notes: Custom deterministic raycast-wheel physics instead of Rapier and vanilla DOM UI instead of React (see report). Handling feel and audio have not been checked by a human; the screenshot comes from the built-in ?autodrive=1 demo driver. No online leaderboard or PWA.
